profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer, ex-Robinhood, ex-Palm WebOS
profile.summary:
I am a full stack software engineer with particular expertise in frontend Web. I care deeply about building tools and products that solve problems for other humans and are delightful to use. Most recently I've focused on accelerating other engineers by building the tools and libraries they need to ship product efficiently, while in my past work I was building the products myself. I have a track record of successfully taking products from inception through a high-quality launch, leading teams during planning, collaborating with stakeholders across the organization, and helping those around me to ship and grow.

I enjoy working with people who care deeply about building high quality software while iterating rapidly and am most motivated when I can see how my work makes a material improvement in people's lives.

positions.title: Product Engineer
positions.description: Building the Customer Studio product, with side hobbies in design system and developer experience.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Technical lead of the Web Platform team, driving an increase in net favorability of over 50 points among web engineers
- Technical lead for frontend web across the company, influencing standards and architecture across all 20+ product teams
- Shipped libraries and tools used by 100+ engineers across dozens of web-based applications
- Led implementation of the web design system, collaborating closely with Design, and drove adoption across all teams 
- Created a scaled mentorship program serving 75+ pairs of web engineers, improving career growth and web community
- Advocated a complete rethink of the core web product, leading to the creation of Robinhood Legend, a brand new product line
- Led design and implementation of cutting-edge scalable frontend infrastructure for Robinhood Legend
Built and maintained an internal Chrome extension used daily by all ~1k engineers, enabling contributions from dozens of others

Key technologies: TypeScript, React, Webpack, Bazel, Emotion, Panda CSS, Jest, Node.js, Playwright, SWC

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Continued the type of work done while under previous titles, as well as tackling the following new challenges. Led multiple projects through the entire product development lifecycle, from "how can we solve this user problem?" through on-time launches. Built multiple new standalone applications from scratch, including all infrastructural work necessary to have them running in production. Served as de facto architectural lead for all front-end web development and reviewed designs for backend projects. Mentored junior and mid-level coworkers.

Technologies used include JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, Jest, Flow, Node.js, Babel, Webpack, React Native, Docker, Nginx, Python, and SQL.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Continued the type of work done while under previous titles, as well as tackling the following new challenges. As part of a small team, seamlessly swapped out Inkling's entire authentication system, including building a new web app, building a new API, and changing the cookie format, without any disruptions to users. Taught myself iOS development to build the alpha version of a new product line targeting a major new market opportunity. Did exploratory prototyping of a new mobile application stack using React Native and Firebase, with the goal of accelerating cross-platform development, and successfully advocated for adoption. Collaborated with the Sales and Customer Success teams to build out internal tooling to enable them to be more autonomous and successful.

Technologies used include JavaScript, HTML, CSS, React, Jest, Flow, Node.js, Babel, Webpack, React Native, Docker, Nginx, Python, Objective-C, Firebase, and SQL.

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Managed a small team of engineers working on Inkling Habitat. Worked closely with Product Management, Design, and Customer Success teams to define schedule, triage incoming bugs and feature requests, ensure the product improved rapidly and consistently while keeping quality high, and build a happy and engaged team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the team that took Inkling Habitat from an in-house tool to an industry-leading digital publishing environment. Served as team lead for Habitat for a year, including through the successful public launch at Tools of Change 2013. Did cutting-edge web development for a single-page application of over 250k lines of JavaScript, which required deep collaboration with Design and Product Management and extensive work with both esoteric and then-modern parts of the web, including the HTML5 file and file system APIs, HSTS, ContentEditable, MathML, SVG, the Document object, and HTML/XHTML parsing and serialization. Introduced the practice of code reviews at Inkling and helped formalize testing practices, all in service of keeping codebases maintainable and the team moving quickly. As team lead, worked with Product Management to define the team's schedule, triage incoming bugs and feature requests, and ensure the product improved rapidly and consistently while keeping quality high.

Also spent time doing server-side development, working to improve and expand the core APIs used by all of Inkling's products, and building out an internal tool to manage application deployments and status. As part of Inkling's shift from B2C to B2B, designed and implemented the critical new layers of the data model, API, and authentication infrastructure necessary to represent each customer as a unique cohesive entity.

Worked with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Backbone.js, Handlebars, SASS, Jasmine, Apache, Node.js, Python, and SQL.

positions.title: Software Applications Developer
positions.description:
During the webOS 1.x releases, wrote the Yahoo contacts sync engine, owned the contacts application and the Google, Facebook, and LinkedIn contacts sync engines, and maintained the accounts service. 

For the webOS 2.0 rewrite, led the redesign of the contacts application and services and served as team lead for several months. Wrote the Google and Yahoo contacts sync engines and owned the other contacts sync engines and the contacts application. Helped design and maintain the sync engine framework.

During the webOS 3.0 timeframe, designed and implemented the Facebook application for the HP TouchPad as part of a small team and worked on other unreleased projects. 

Worked with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Java, SQL, a proprietary NoSQL database, Node.js, CoffeeScript, and LESS.

positions.title: Application Development Intern
positions.description: Designed and implemented a Facebook contacts sync engine and part of a contacts application.  Application and sync engine were designed for a smartphone, forcing design decisions to consider the small form factor and power profiles.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant, CS 107 - Programming Paradigms
positions.description: CS 107 is part of the introductory sequence of classes for students just learning to program.  Graded programs and exams, held office hours, and helped students debug programs and understand material.

positions.title: Application Development Intern
positions.description: Worked with a small team to design, build, and test a complete messaging application able to track online status, persist data, and integrate with other applications.  Personally implemented the UI and the account management portion.  Built an application to automate black-box testing of messaging application logic.  Applications were designed for a smartphone, forcing design decisions to consider the small form factor, power profiles.

positions.title: House Manager, 717 Dolores House
positions.description: Worked as part of a six-person team to manage a 33-person house.  Planned and held events for residents, helped run the house kitchen, and served as the liaison between residents and Stanford Housing.

positions.title: Systems Development Intern
positions.description: Built a thermal test bench to automatically collect thermal data on a system for various compute loads and fan configurations.  Enabled more efficient research on thermal characteristics of systems and fan speed control.  Developed test procedure for proper use of the thermal test bench and provided training to the system team.  Worked with LabVIEW.

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description: Added new features to an existing web-based administration interface.  Took new interface version through full software development cycle: collected requirements; designed the interface; coded and debugged the software; and performed maintenance and troubleshooting after release.  Developed design for internal job-posting board.  Worked with C#, ASP.NET, SQL.

positions.title: Programming Intern
positions.description: Created dynamically generated web pages linked to sales databases to enable better understanding of sales data.  Worked in a small team to redesign databases.  Position initially attained through the competitive Apprenticeships in Science and Engineering program.  Worked with HTML, PHP, JavaScript, and SQL.

patents.title: System and method for displaying content according to a target format for presentation on a target presentation device
patents.description: A user interface for presenting a set of related pages of an electronic content work for view at the same time. The pages are sized according to a target format for presentation of the electronic content work, and may also be formatted according to user-defined font and zoom criteria. Each of the related pages comprises a media object, for example a markup language object. Responsive to user manipulation of presentation criterion for the set of related pages, the set of related pages is reformatted and so presented in near real-time. In some instances, a user may manipulate controls of the user interface to isolate a content object included within the set of related pages, have information regarding that content object presented and even edit the content object in-line with the present view.

patents.title: Systems and methods for creating, editing and publishing cross-platform interactive electronic works
patents.description: Systems and methods for creating, editing and publishing cross-platform interactive digital content works include a content management component configured to store portions of a digital content work and to implement version control of the digital content work; a defect tracking component configured to store a defect record related to a stored portion of the digital content work; a publication pipeline component configured to format the digital content work for publication; and a integration component configured to present a graphical user interface which allows for editing the stored portions of the digital content work, editing the defect record, and instructing the publication pipeline to format the digital content work for publication.
